caption: The drawing depicts a fan-shaped design featuring a large bird, likely a peacock, at its center with its wings outstretched and feathers fanned out in a semicircular arrangement. The peacock is rendered in tones of gold, yellow, and brown, with individual feathers detailed using oval eye-spot patterns. Below the bird, at the central base of the fan shape, there is a human face with symmetrical, curling, hair-like extensions resembling tendrils or stylized feathers, also in gold and brown hues. The background is a plain light beige, with the composition framed by a thin, lightly colored arc outlining the semicircular shape. The image is composed symmetrically around a vertical axis running through the bird and human face.
title: Peacock Cabin Decoration
